subject: [PATCH v4 0/3] fs/proc/task_mmu: smaps fixes for non-present and device-private PMDs

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch series, specifically the first patch, which reads the PMD once in smaps_pmd_entry().

2026-11-25.patch_summary: This patch series addresses two issues in the smaps PMD path, where it incorrectly reads accessed and dirty bits from non-present PMDs and fails to account device-private PMDs correctly. The patches also include a cleanup that was extracted from work on PMD swap entries for anonymous THPs.
